summary: This directory provides utilities for loading and managing prompt templates. It focuses on abstracting the retrieval of prompt files to support template-based generation tasks within the application pipeline.
responsibilities: Load prompt templates from the filesystem
Resolve prompt paths based on module location
relationships: The prompt loader uses the current module path to locate and load specific prompt template files.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of file loading logic within a factory function
Relative path resolution to ensure portability of prompts across modules
